title: The Surya Pharmaceuticals Multi-Bank Fraud
dek: A Delhi-based drugmaker allegedly siphoned funds through group companies, defrauding Punjab & Sind Bank and four other lenders of over ₹620 crore — a case that surfaced just as Indian banks were tightening scrutiny after the Nirav Modi scandal broke.

heroStat.label: allegedly defrauded from Punjab & Sind Bank and four other lenders by Surya Pharmaceuticals and its promoters

promise.quote: Credit facilities extended to Surya Pharmaceuticals would be used for their stated business purposes and repaid according to sanctioned terms, as required under the consortium lending agreement.
promise.madeBy: Surya Pharmaceuticals Ltd and its promoters, borrowing from a consortium including Punjab & Sind Bank
promise.role: Delhi-based pharmaceutical company and consortium borrower
promise.context: This reflects the standard borrower obligation under consortium lending covenants rather than a specific loan agreement this entry has reviewed directly.

target.description: Repayment of consortium credit facilities according to sanctioned terms, without diversion of borrowed funds to group companies or misrepresentation of the company's financial position.
target.standard: RBI's fraud-classification norms for non-performing asset accounts and standard consortium lending covenants.

reality.description: Punjab & Sind Bank filed a complaint alleging that Surya Pharmaceuticals, its two promoters, and a Dubai-based company defrauded it and four other banks of a combined amount reported at around ₹621 crore (US$94.57 million at the time), allegedly by siphoning off borrowed funds through group companies. The CBI opened an investigation in April 2018 — reported at the time as coming amid heightened bank vigilance following the Nirav Modi–Punjab National Bank scandal that had surfaced earlier that year — and conducted searches at seven locations, recovering documents. This investigation has not located reporting confirming a subsequent chargesheet, trial outcome, or recovery status.
